question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **surrounding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"surrounding"** means something that is all around a particular place or thing. (आस-पास)

 
 
• **Example: **The surrounding area of the park is filled with beautiful trees and flowers.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **surrounding.**
